note: Data-only trigger-routing fixtures (plugin-wide-6 / batch C4). There is no built-in eval runner; these cases are the fresh-session A/B baseline corpus recorded BEFORE the C1 description POV batch. Post-run user-verification artifact, not a merge gate.

evals.expected_behavior: Colloquial second-opinion ask on a PR: by default one fresh reviewer maps what the PR changed, finds every place that states or relies on each changed fact, walks each one with the principles it triggers, and reports every place that fails to hold — says the opposite, omits what it owes, or does not get what it needs — as two citations with its chain, plus one line per standing question. Nothing is run.

evals.prompt: Take a look at this plan the model produced
evals.expected_behavior: Casual 'take a look at X' on model output triggers independent re-verification.

evals.prompt: 模型說已經完成了，幫我 check 一下是不是真的
evals.expected_behavior: Post-'done' declaration: verify the completion claim independently, surfacing hallucinations and drift.
看一下 + an existing error is symptom-to-root-cause debugging — routes to $baransu:hunt.

evals.prompt: 看一下我的 claude 配置對不對
evals.expected_behavior: Auditing the user's own agent configuration routes to $baransu:health, not $baransu:review.

evals.prompt: 看一下這個 PR 是不是做過頭了，加了一堆防呆
evals.expected_behavior: Excess / over-defence question on a PR: standing question 2 (added what was not asked) leads; the reviewer loads goal and taste principles, and a guard for a state no caller produces is a problem with its cost as the impact.
A single line is still a change with facts and places: the default single reviewer walks the places that line's facts reach, runs nothing, and keeps the report short.
